capabilities: Colour sentences by role with a local instruct model
Highlight key phrases, citations and definitions with embedding and GLiNER2 models
Edit colour codes and force or forbid colours with custom rules
Link colour codes to notes or folders
Adjust colour sensitivity with a slider and per-paragraph caching
disambiguation: Not an editing or formatting tool; it only draws colours over the text and the note itself is never changed.
extras: Requires downloading a separate model server and models (about 8.5 GB once); an NVIDIA GPU with about 4 GB free memory is recommended, otherwise it runs slower on CPU. Mobile can only use a server running on another computer. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to visually mark the role of sentences and phrases for skim reading long notes.
summary: Reading aid that colours each sentence and key phrase by its role using local AI models, drawing over the note without changing it.
